summary: Installed .git/hooks/post-commit that calls claude --dangerously-skip-permissions to selectively stage .graph/ files newer than .git/COMMIT_EDITMSG after each code commit. Flag ORCH_GRAPH_AUTOCOMMIT=1 in ~/.claude/settings.json env block enables it. Test commit made; awaiting snapshot commit to confirm hook fires.

subject: Add graph auto-commit post-commit hook with on/off flag
description: Create .git/hooks/post-commit that checks ORCH_GRAPH_AUTOCOMMIT=1, then calls claude CLI to selectively stage .graph/ files modified since the last commit and commit them. Add the env flag to ~/.claude/settings.json with a comment. Hook must run in background (non-blocking) and use --no-verify to avoid recursion.
